notes.title: VILLAGE BUSINESSMAN the 1.2 Update.
notes.content:
Update 1.2.
1. Fixed bugs|bugs:
1. Fixed a bug where after the purchase of the company, there was no income.
2. Changes:
1. From the store, as well as near the store, were removed: truck and trailers.
  2. 2 trains were added to the store: "Blue train" and "Green train", when they are used from the inventory, they will appear in the depot. (In order to send one of them to fulfill contracts, you need to go to the depot, then go to the office, go to the board with the name of the train you need, press the key: "F" and select the contract to which you want to send the train.( You will not be able to re-take the contract until the train returns to the depot))
[previewyoutube=7aICyF_m-g4;full][/previewyoutube]
 3. The supports of the conductive wires were removed.( may be returned in one of the future updates)
4. now when you come for the material: "log", you will be able to notice how the leaves fall from the trees, and when mining, you can see how the tree falls.
[previewyoutube=tsaabje4fgs;full][/previewyoutube]
5. changed the physics of some vehicles.

notes.title: VILLAGE BUSINESSMAN the 1.1 Update.
notes.content:
Update 1.1.
1.fixed bugs:
1. fixed a bug where the 2nd inventory appeared after loading a saved game.
  2. Fixed a bug where you could drown on land.
2. Changes: 
 1. By default, the inventory will be closed.
  2. Changed my animation.
  3. Visual changes.
3. known bugs in this update:
1. when saving the game While in the vehicle and loading the game, only the character will be in the vehicle's place.
  1.5. when you save the game while outside the vehicle and load the same save, but In the vehicle, you will not be able to get back into this vehicle.
( temporary solution 3.-1.1.5: Save the character only outside the vehicle, and load the save as well, outside the vehicle)
